t: Dorab Wolf Herring, Chirocentrus dorab (Forsskal, 1775) - The Australian Museum
s: The Dorab Wolf Herring has an elongate, compressed body with a sharp belly. The body is covered with small cycloid scales. The single dorsal fin and anal fin are positioned in the posterior half of the body. The upward-directed mouth has large canine teeth in both jaws.

t: Chirocentrus dorab
s: A large voracious predator with many dagger-like teeth in the jaws. The Dorab Wolf Herring is elongate and very compressed, dark bluish-green above, bright silvery on the sides and below, with blackish outer dorsal-fin rays and blackish anterior anal-fin rays.

t: Dorab Wolf Herring (Chirocentrus dorab) · iNaturalist
s: The dorab wolf-herring (Chirocentrus dorab) is a fish species from the Chirocentrus genus of the Chirocentridae family. It is a coastal fish, silvery below and bright blue above. It is found in both marine and brackish or estuarine waters, feeding on smaller fish and possibly crustaceans.
